description: Na₃SiH₃O₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one H and five O atoms. The Na-H bond length is 2.37 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.51 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one H and four O atoms. The Na-H bond length is 2.31 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.43 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.48 Å. Si is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.72 Å. There are three inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na and two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.03 Å) and one longer (1.59 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.00 Å) and one longer (1.76 Å) H-O bond length. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.01 Å) and one longer (1.71 Å) H-O bond length. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na and one Si atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₄Si trigonal bipyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Si, and one H atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Si, and two H atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two Na and two H atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Si, and one H atom.
